# SimpleX

> SimpleX is the first messaging network without user identifiers of any kind – no phone numbers, usernames or random IDs – so nobody, including its servers, can see who talks to whom. SimpleX Chat is the free, open-source app for iOS, Android, Linux, macOS and Windows that uses this network, and the company that builds both.

Each conversation uses its own one-way message queues with random addresses, and contacts are stored only on users' devices. Messages are end-to-end encrypted with a double ratchet that adds a post-quantum key exchange on every step. Anyone can run servers; SimpleX Chat and Flux operate the servers preset in the app. Trail of Bits assessed the implementation in 2022 and reviewed the cryptographic design in 2024.

Every page of simplex.chat is also available as Markdown: replace `.html` with `.md` (simplex.chat/docs/simplex.md), or add `.md` to the path (simplex.chat/why.md).
